		<headline>The meteorological observatory of Lin an District in Hangzhou issued a blue rainstorm warning [Level IV/general]</headline>
		<description>At 11:20 on November 4, 2026, the meteorological observatory of Lin an District, Hangzhou City issued a blue rainstorm warning signal: Affected by the rain clouds, it is expected that there will be heavy to rainstorm in Qingliangfeng, Tuankou, Heqiao, Qianchuan and other towns (streets) in our district today. Please pay attention to prevent the secondary disasters such as mountain torrents, debris flows, landslides and urban and rural waterlogging that may be caused by heavy rainfall in small flow areas.</description>
		<instruction>1. The government and relevant departments should pay attention to the dynamics of early warning signals and make emergency preparations for rainstorm prevention; 2. Relevant responsible units shall inspect the drainage system and prepare for drainage in low-lying and flood prone areas; 3.
